    BGRS chains, tackles, and efficiency #

    Definition 1.9 of BGRS has two alternating nonfactorization shapes. A tackle is such a chain whose last morphism is irreducible; Section 8.4 orders tackles from one starting object by the lexicographic word of component depths.

          structure LargeIndecomposable.RayHookChain {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms C] (m : ℕ) :
          Type (max u v)

          The first chain shape of BGRS 1.9. It has m+1 morphisms rho, m morphisms sigma, and ends with rho_m; the associated tackle is a hook tackle.

          • valley_incomparable (i : Fin m) : RaySourceIncomparable (self.sigma i) (self.rho i.succ)

                                            theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayTackle.exists_isEfficientAt_of_exists_start {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms C] [HasFiniteRayPathDepth C] [Finite (RayTackle C)] (y : C) (hy : ∃ (t : RayTackle C), t.start = y) :
                                            ∃ (t : RayTackle C), IsEfficientAt y t
